_comment: Cards that exist only for the mana-spent-from test (tests/unit/mana/test_mana_spent_from.py). Never part of a deck list. `t_desert_prospect` is Cataclysmic Prospecting's Treasure clause on a fixed cost; `t_desert_digger` is the same count on a creature's enters trigger; `t_twin_desert` is a Desert that makes two mana in one activation, which a set of sources counts once.

cards.name: Test Desert Prospect
cards.oracle_text: For each mana from a Desert spent to cast this spell, create a tapped Treasure token.

cards.name: Test Desert Digger
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token for each mana from a Desert spent to cast it.

abilities.text: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token for each mana from a Desert spent to cast it.
